author: Ari Koslow
title: George Lombard suffers wrist injury in Triple-A
desc: Yankees INF prospect George Lombard Jr. injured his wrist during Tuesday's game for Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
impact: Lombard suffered the injury applying a tag at second base. He'll be further evaluated at which point an update should be provided.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) throws 63 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Tyler Mahle threw 63 pitches over three innings in a rehab start on Tuesday for Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Mahle threw just 33 of his 63 pitches for strikes, allowing one run on one hit. He walked five and struck out three. He'll likely make at least one more rehab start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Burrows to have next start skipped
desc: Mike Burrows will have his start skipped against the Guardians this weekend.
impact: The return of Hunter Brown will allow Houston to skip Burrows next start. It will be Tatsuya Imai, Spencer Arrighetti, and Kai-Wei Teng starting this weekend against Cleveland.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Santana hit by pitch three times in rehab game
desc: Carlos Santana was hit by a pitch three times in the Arizona Complex League on Tuesday.
impact: Santana was removed from the game in the sixth inning. He has been working his way back from a groin injury followed by an oblique strain.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Trevor Megill nails down save as Brewers edge Guardians
desc: Trevor Megill struck out two batters in a scoreless outing to earn the save in Tuesday's 2-1 win over the Guardians.
impact: Megill continues a strong stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in 10 of his last 11 trips to the mound. The right-hander has returned to a reliable option after a rough start to the season in the Brewers bullpen, posting a 4.15 ERA and 1.12 WHIP with nine saves, six holds, and a 12.5 K/9 ratio across 27 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Maikel Garcia (hand) out of lineup Wednesday
desc: Maikel Garcia is not in the Royals lineup on Wednesday against the Nationals.
impact: Garcia was removed early from Tuesday's game with hand soreness. Nick Loftin will start at third base in his place.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gleyber Torres (side) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Gleyber Torres is not in the Tigers lineup on Wednesday against the Astros.
impact: Torres is sitting a second straight game following his early exit on Monday. Hao-Yu Lee will draw another start at second base.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carson Whisenhunt to start Game 2 of doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Giants manager Tony Vitello said Carson Whisenhunt will start Game 2 of the doubleheader against the Braves on Wednesday.
impact: Whisenhunt will earn his first start of the season. He could earn more of an opportunity if he pitches well on Wednesday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Robert Gasser flirts with a shutout in no-decision
desc: Robert Gasser allowed two hits and two walks while striking out five over 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Tuesday's 2-1 win over the Guardians.
impact: Gasser continues a steady stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in three of his five contests. The left-hander remains one of the more inconsistent options in the Brewers clubhouse, posting a 4.88 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 0-3 record and 2.2 K/BB ratio across five starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Davis Martin torched early in loss to Yankees
desc: Davis Martin allowed nine earned runs on eight hits and three walks while striking out four over 3 1/3 innings in Tuesday's loss to the Yankees.
impact: Martin has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last five contests. The right-hander remains one of the more steady options in the White Sox rotation for manager Will Venable, carrying a 3.31 ERA and 1.19 WHIP to go with a 9-3 record and 9.2 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Benintendi homers in lopsided loss
desc: Andrew Benintendi went 1-for-2 in a loss to the Yankees with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Benintendi has heated up at the plate of late, driving in runs in three of his last four contests. The veteran remains one of the more inconsistent options in the White Sox lineup for manager Will Venable, batting .239 with eight homers, 33 RBI, 29 runs scored, and one stolen base across 64 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Zack Gelof stays hot in loss to Pirates
desc: Zack Gelof went 3-for-3 in the loss to the Pirates with a home run, three hits, two runs scored, two RBI, one walk, and one stolen base.
impact: Gelof continues a torrid stretch at the plate, extending his hitting streak to 20 games Tuesday night. The 26-year-old remains one of the more stable options in a streaky Athletics lineup, hitting .286 with 10 homers, 28 RBI, 34 runs, and eight steals through 57 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jack Perkins offers mixed results Tuesday against Pirates
desc: Jack Perkins allowed three earned runs on six hits and two walks while striking out six over five innings in Tuesday's 6-5 loss to the Pirates.
impact: Perkins has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last three trips to the mound. The right-hander remains difficult to trust despite flashing top-tier swing-and-miss stuff at times for manager Mark Kotsay, posting a 6.15 ERA and 1.39 WHIP with a 2-3 record and 10.8 K/9 ratio through 20 appearances this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Brown limits damage in win over Tigers
desc: Hunter Brown allowed one earned run on three hits and three walks while striking out seven over 5 2/3 innings in Tuesday's win over the Tigers.
impact: Brown was strong in his first start since returning from injury, allowing one earned run or less in his three trips to the mound. The right- hander offers manager Joe Espada an impactful option in a disappointing Astros rotation, carrying a 1.10 ERA and 1.04 WHIP with a 1-0 record and 13.2 K/9 ratio through three starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Josh Hader locks down save in win over Tigers
desc: Josh Hader struck out one batter while allowing one hit over a scoreless inning to earn the save in Tuesday's 4-2 win over the Tigers.
impact: Hader continues a strong stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in each of his six trips to the mound. The left-hander has rewarded fantasy managers with an impactful closer option in his return, posting a 0.00 ERA and 0.33 WHIP with three saves and a 12.0 K/9 ratio through six appearances.
